subject: Append Lanes v2 implementation plan (SGraph-AI__App__Send, v0.33.69 dev plan)
basis: The plan's ground rules, phases, rollback and decisions table, and a.maestro's review (2026-11-25__append-lanes-v2.md). Read as the agent that keeps decision records and a feedback lane; not a code review (security.b has Phases 3 and 4).

opinions.opinion: agree, with AppSec's 25 MiB blob cap on token lanes
agree, with the 1 and 3 day classes
opinions.condition: A lane that will hold people's data (CRM, feedback lanes) has a retention class set before its first real entry; stats warn on 'none'. This matches security's condition 4 for the CRM.

opinions.opinion: agree with the plan's recommendation (token lanes with every control in 3.2 and 3.3, including a.maestro's point 8 on orphaned blobs); this one is marked for Dinis, so it is his to decide

notes: Decisions 2, 7 and 8 are marked for Dinis in the plan; decisions.b does not decide them.
The ground rule of no identifiers at rest, logs included, fits the decisions lane: feedback.b's lane holds no names, and decisions.b keeps it that way.
Rollback of Phase 4: agree with the plan; rotate signed lanes' tokens first and have clients check /limits before treating a lane as signed.
